# 2003 Elections

There were 4 elections held in Jersey in 2003.

- **[Senator By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2003#e4)**

  1 seat · 5 candidates · 26.3% turnout
- **[St Ouen Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2003#e28)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[Grouville Connétable By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2003#e23)**

  1 seat · 2 candidates · 47.1% turnout
- **[St John Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2003#e24)**

  1 seat · 2 candidates · 57.4% turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

* * *

* * *

## 2003 Senator By-Election

By-election following the retirement of Ann Bailhache (1 seat), 26th February 2003.

**[Ted Vibert](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ted-vibert) was elected as Senator**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Ted Vibert](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ted-vibert)** |  | 3,983 | 31.7% |
| 2 | [Alastair Layzell](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alastair-layzell) |  | 3,712 | 29.5% |
| 3 | [Ian McFirbishigh](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-mcfirbishigh) |  | 2,487 | 19.8% |
| 4 | [Geno Gouveia](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geno-gouveia) |  | 1,761 | 14% |
| 5 | [Harry Cole](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/harry-cole) |  | 489 | 3.9% |

12,571 votes (inc. 139 spoilt papers)

47,825 registered voters

26.3% turnout

## 2003 St Ouen Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Ouen](https://flow.je/elections/st-ouen) (1 seat), 6th August 2003.

**[Ken Vibert](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ken-vibert) was elected as Connétable of St Ouen in 2003 unopposed**.

#### Sources

- [https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2003/08/07/st-ouen-constable-in-for-a-fourth-term/](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2003/08/07/st-ouen-constable-in-for-a-fourth-term/)

## 2003 Grouville Connétable By-Election

By-election following the resignation of Frank Amy due to ill-health (1 seat), 17th September 2003.

**[Dan Murphy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy) was elected as Connétable of Grouville in 2003**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Dan Murphy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy)** |  | 851 | 62.5% |
| 2 | [Bruce Willing](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bruce-willing) |  | 505 | 37.1% |
| 3 | ~~[John Lamy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-lamy)~~ |  | Withdrew |  |

1,361 votes (inc. 5 spoilt papers)

2,892 registered voters

47.1% turnout

## 2003 St John Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St John](https://flow.je/elections/st-john) (1 seat), 3rd December 2003.

**[Richard Dupré](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/richard-dupre) was elected as Connétable of St John in 2003**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Richard Dupré](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/richard-dupre)** |  | 538 | 58.1% |
| 2 | [Christopher Taylor](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/christopher-taylor) |  | 386 | 41.7% |

926 votes (inc. 2 spoilt papers)

1,612 registered voters

57.4% turnout
